newsitem.title: UK: S&P rates Nuernberger AG AA minus claims-paying.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Nuernberger AG AA minus claims-paying.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Tuesday it had assigned Nuernberger Allgemeine Versicherungs AG (NAV) an AA minus claims-paying ability rating.
"The rating is based on NAVs good position in the German motor market, its multi distribution channels, its strong operating performance and its excellent capitalisation," S&P said in a statement.
S&P said these strengths were partially offset by NAV's reliance on the German motor sector which, following tariff liberlisation, had become increasingly competitive.
"In order to compete effectively in this difficult environment, S&P believes that management will continue instituting efficiency measures to help bringing down costs," the rating agency said.
S&P said it expected NAV to maintain its strong position in the motor market, thanks to its close relationship with the German car dealers' association.

"Following substanial investments in technology, NAV's expense ratio is expected to improve somewhat. However, the increased competition in the German motor market implies that 1995 underwriting result was probably a peak. Nonetheless, capitalisation is expected to remain excellent," S&P said.
